title: Past Perfect / Ɛberɛ a ɛda (ɛberɛ a ɛfiri ɛberɛ)
bridge: Wɔ Twi, ɛberɛ a ɛda (sane a ɛda) ka yɛde maa ako a ɛyɛe wɔ ɛberɛ a ɛfiri ɛberɛ. Wɔ English, past perfect (had eaten) maa wɔde maa ako a ɛyɛe wɔ ɛberɛ a ɛfiri ɛberɛ, nanso wɔyɛ anidaso bi: ɛda a wɔde bɛka kan no sɛe (wɔ English, ɛne 'had + past participle' daa), na wɔ English no, wɔde 'already', 'just', 'never' maa wɔde bɛyɛ ɛkwan a wɔde bɛka. Hwɛ: wɔ Twi, yɛde ɛberɛ a ɛyɛe (sane) wɔn a wɔwɔ hɔ bio wɔ English no, wɔde past perfect (had eaten) maa wɔde bɛyɛ ɛkwan a wɔde bɛka. Afei, wɔ Twi no, wɔde 'haber' maa wɔde bɛyɛ ɛberɛ a ɛda, na wɔ English no, 'had' no wɔhwe wɔ wɔn nyinaa so.
rule: Wɔde past perfect maa wɔde bɛyɛ ɛkwan a wɔde bɛka wɔ 'had' (wɔ wɔn nyinaa so) + past participle a wɔde bɛka. Wɔde maa wɔde bɛyɛ ako a ɛyɛe wɔ ɛberɛ a ɛfiri ɛberɛ, nea ɛne 'ɛberɛ a ɛfiri ɛberɛ'. Wɔ kyerɛwwoμ: ɔkɔmfo + had + past participle. Wɔ kyerɛntumi: had not (hadn't) + past participle. Wɔ kyerɛkyerɛ: Had + ɔkɔmfo + past participle. Wɔde maa wɔde bɛyɛ ɛkwan a wɔde bɛka wɔ 'already', 'just', 'never', 'ever', 'by the time', 'before', 'after'. Adwene: 'Mɛyɛɛ me hwɛfoμ no ho asɛm a ɛfiri ɛberɛ'. Wɔde maa wɔde bɛyɛ ɛkwan a wɔde bɛka wɔ ɛda a wɔde bɛka (present perfect -> past perfect). Anidaso: wɔ English no, wɔde 'after' na 'before' maa wɔde bɛyɛ ɛkwan a wɔde bɛka, nanso wɔde past perfect maa wɔde bɛyɛ ɛkwan a wɔde bɛka.

title: Conditionals Type 1 and 2 / Nnyinasoɔ 1 ne 2
bridge: Wɔ Twi, yɛnkyɛ yɛbɔ present subjunctive wɔ conditional clause ne simple conditional wɔ main clause (Sɛ mɛwɔ twe, mɛgye). Wɔ English, structure no different: wɔ first conditional, yɛbɔ simple present wɔ 'if' clause ne future with 'will' wɔ main clause. Wɔ second conditional, yɛbɔ simple past wɔ 'if' clause ne 'would' + infinitive wɔ main clause. Hwehwɛ: wɔ English, simple past wɔ second conditional no ma time past, na hypothetical anaa unreal situation wɔ present anaa future. Mommma ɛha wo ban ma translate literally from Spanish, efisɛ structures no different.
rule: First conditional (type 1) yɛ ma real anaa possible situations wɔ present anaa future. Yɛbɔ: If + subject + verb wɔ simple present, + subject + will + base verb. Example: If it rains, we will stay at home. 'If' clause nea ɛba paa anaa ɛkɛse, na sɛ ɛba paa a, yɛbɔ comma. Yɛmmaa 'unless' (unless) nkyerɛ 'if not'. Second conditional (type 2) yɛ ma hypothetical, improbable anaa unreal situations wɔ present anaa future. Yɛbɔ: If + subject + verb wɔ simple past, + subject + would + base verb. Example: If I had more money, I would travel. Wɔ second conditional, verb 'to be' yɛ ma 'were' for all persons (If I were...). Yɛmmma 'was' wɔ formal context, although wɔ informal English sometimes yɛbɔ. Yɛmmaa 'could' anaa 'might' nkyerɛ 'would' ma express possibility anaa ability. Second conditional yɛ ma give advice ('If I were you, I would...') ne express imaginary wishes.

title: Passive Voice: Present & Past / Kɔbɔ a ɛnyɛ wo a ɛyɛ ne a ɛda
bridge: Wɔ Twi, kɔbɔ a ɛnyɛ wo a ɛyɛ ne a ɛda de 'be' + past participle, sɛnea ɛyɛ wɔ English (to be + past participle). Nanso, wɔ English, agent complement no wɔhyia no wɔ 'by', na wɔ Twi yɛ're 'by'. Enti, wɔ English, passive voice no so subject no nye so akɔntɔ a wɔde ma no bɛyɛ a, na wɔ Twi, yɛnkyɛ active voice anaa reflective passive ('se') a yɛbɛka. Ɛkyɛ a wɔyɛ no yɛɛ wɔde 'to be' verb no kɔ anaa wɔkunkum past participle no nkɔm.
rule: Kɔbɔ a ɛnyɛ wo a ɛyɛ ne a ɛda de 'to be' verb no wɔ tense a ɛwɔ no mu (present simple: am/is/are; past simple: was/were) + past participle of the main verb. Active sentence no subject no yɛɛ agent complement no wɔ 'by' (ɛnyɛ biribiara na ɛyɛ, ɛno a ɛnyɛ paa). Sɛ wopɛ sɛ wɔbɛka passive voice no, active sentence no object no yɛɛ subject no. Abasɔrɔ: Active: 'The chef cooks the meal' → Passive: 'The meal is cooked by the chef'. Wɔ present, yɛde 'is/are' sɛ subject no yɛ singular/plural. Wɔ past, yɛde 'was/were'. Past participle no yɛ verb no third form (regular: -ed; irregular: list). Exception: Wɔnnyɛ passive voice wɔ intransitive verbs (wɔnnyɛ object). Typical usage: Sɛ agent no ɛnyɛ biribiara, ɛyɛ paa anaa ɛnyɛ paa a action no nye so akɔntɔ a.

title: Reported Speech / Nkyerɛso nkɔso a ɛyɛ den
bridge: Wɔ Twi, sɛ yɛbɛka kyerɛw nkyerɛso a, yɛbɔ mmerɛ a ɛwɔ hɔ no asɛm (sɛ 'ɔkaa sɛ ɔyɛ adwene), na wɔ English so, sɛ yɛbɛka kyerɛw nkyerɛso a, yɛbɔ mmerɛ a ɛwɔ hɔ no asɛm na yɛbɔ mmerɛ biara a ɛwɔ hɔ no asɛm: mmara, mmerɛ a ɛwɔ hɔ no asɛm, na ɛsɛe a wɔde ka asɛm no. Mmerɛ a ɛyɛ den biara ne sɛ wɔbɔ mmerɛ a ɛwɔ hɔ no asɛm (ɔkaa sɛ 'I am tired' → *She said she is tired), nanso wɔ English B1 no, yɛbɔ 'backshift': 'She said she was tired'. Mmerɛ biara a ɛwɔ hɔ no ne sɛ wɔ English no, wɔmmusua 'that' sɛ ɛyɛ den (wommu 'She said she was tired' anaa 'She said that she was tired'), nanso wɔ Twi no, 'que' no yɛ den.
rule: Nkyerɛso nkɔso a ɛyɛ den no yɛ sɛ wɔde kyerɛw sɛdeɛ obi ka. Wɔ English no, mmara a wɔde bɔ no ne 'say' anaa 'tell'. 'Say' no mmusua obi a wɔde kyerɛw no (He said he was happy), nanso 'tell' no yɛ den sɛ wɔde kyerɛw obi a wɔde kyerɛw no (He told me he was happy). Mmerɛ a ɛwɔ hɔ no asɛm: 1) Mmerɛ a ɛwɔ hɔ no (present→past, past→past perfect): 'I am' → 'she was', 'I went' → 'she had gone'. 2) Mmara: 'I' → 'he/she', 'my' → 'his/her'. 3) Mmerɛ a ɛwɔ hɔ no asɛm: 'today'→'that day', 'tomorrow'→'the next day', 'yesterday'→'the day before'. 4) Mmerɛ a ɛwɔ hɔ no: 'here'→'there'. Mmerɛ a ɛyɛ den: sɛ ɔkwan no ka a, wommu mmerɛ a ɛwɔ hɔ no asɛm (She said she is tired - sɛ ɔyɛ adwene). Sɛ ɛyɛ kyerɛw a, wommu 'if' anaa 'whether' sɛ ɛyɛ kyerɛw a ɛyɛ anaa ɛnyɛ, na wommu asɛm a ɛyɛ kyerɛw no sɛ ɛyɛ kyerɛw a ɛyɛ den (He asked me where I lived, no 'where did I live'). Sɛ ɛyɛ kyerɛw a ɛyɛ den anaa ɛyɛ kyerɛw a ɛyɛ den a, wommu 'tell/ask + obi + to + infinitive' (He told me to sit down).

title: Gerunds and Infinitives as Subject and Object / Gerundia ne Infinitivia wɔ Subject ne Object
bridge: Wɔ Twi, yɛnkyɛm infinitive de yɛ subject ne bere a wɔhyia verb biara a wɔde kyerɛw wo (sɛ, 'nadar es divertido', 'me gusta nadar'). Wɔ English, nkyɛn kyɛn biara: bere bi yɛ gerund (-ing) ne bere biara yɛ infinitive (to + verb). Kyerɛw biara ne sɛ, sɛ action no yɛ subject akyerɛw no anaa object a wɔhyia verb biara sɛ 'enjoy' anaa 'finish', yɛ gerund. Sɛ yɛhyia verb biara sɛ 'want' anaa 'decide', yɛ infinitive. Yɛn kyerɛw biara ne sɛ, wɔ Hispanohablantes, nsuo bi nni hɔ a ɛde yɛn akoma.
rule: Wɔ English, verb no ara ne gerund (verb + -ing) ne infinitive (to + base form). Sɛ subject a, gerund yɛ kyerɛw biara ne natural (sɛ, 'Swimming is healthy'). Sɛ object a, yɛn de verb a wɔhyia no: verb biara de gerund (enjoy, finish, avoid, suggest, consider), verb biara de infinitive (want, need, decide, hope, plan). Verb biara de kyerɛw biara sɛ wɔde 'stop' anaa 'remember'. Wɔ B1 students, yɛn de verb biara a wɔhyia no ne sɛ yɛde example biara.

title: Modal Verbs for Deduction / Nkyerɛasɛmfoɔ a wɔde ma adwuma (must, might, could)
bridge: Wɔ Twi mu, yɛde 'debe de' ma dedukʃɔn a ɛwɔ kyerɛw sɛ ɛbɛyɛ, 'puede que' ma awerɛhow guu, na 'podría' ma nkyerɛw a ɛnyɛ paa. Nanso, wɔ English mu, mmara bi wɔ: nkyerɛasɛmfoɔ no nte-nteɛ na wɔnntɔn 'to'. Nkyerɛw bi aka ho asɛm ne sɛ wɔ Twi mu yɛde abasɛm ('será') ma adwuma, nanso wɔ English mu yɛde 'must' + kwan a verb bi wɔ. Sɛ woka ho nhwɛ so a, ɛbɛyɛ sɛ wɔde Twi kasa kyerɛ English. Bu: wɔ English mu, dedukʃɔn ka ho asɛm wɔ hɔ wɔ nkyerɛasɛm + verb a ɛwɔ kwan mu, ‘to’ nni hɔ, na kyerɛw no ne sɛ: subject + nkyerɛasɛm + verb.
rule:
Wɔ English mu, sɛ yɛbɛka dedukʃɔn a ɛwɔ hɔ a, yɛde 'must', 'might' na 'could'. 
- **Must** + verb a ɛwɔ kwan mu: ɛma yɛn kyerɛw sɛ dedukʃɔn bi wɔ kyerɛw sɛ ɛbɛyɛ paa (logic, evidence a ɛwɔ kyerɛw sɛ ɛbɛyɛ). Ɛte 'debe de' wɔ Twi mu. Kyekye: 'She must be at home' (Ɛsɛ sɛ ɔwɔ hɔ). 
- **Might** + verb a ɛwɔ kwan mu: ɛma yɛn kyerɛw sɛ awerɛhow guu, anidaso. Ɛte 'puede que' anaa 'quizás'. Kyekye: 'He might be sick' (Ɛsɛ sɛ ɔyɛ adwuma). 
- **Could** + verb a ɛwɔ kwan mu: ɛma yɛn kyerɛw sɛ awerɛhow guu, nanso wɔde maa yɛn kyerɛw sɛ nkyerɛw bi wɔ, nanso ɛnyɛ paa. Ɛte 'podría'. Kyekye: 'It could rain today' (Ɛsɛ sɛ obi bɛma yɛn). 

**Nneɛma:** Nkyerɛasɛmfoɔ no nte-nteɛ wɔ hɔn a wɔde kasa (wɔnntɔn '-s' wɔ he/she/it mu). Wɔnntɔn 'to' wɔ wɔn akyi. Sɛ wɔbɛyɛ 'must' a ɛwɔ dedukʃɔn mu a, yɛde 'can't' (nnom 'mustn't'): 'She can't be at work' (Ɛnyɛ sɛ ɔwɔ adwuma). 

**Adwuma:** Yɛde yɛn ma dedukʃɔn a ɛwɔ hɔ mu. Sɛ dedukʃɔn a ɛda paa a, yɛde 'must have + participio', 'might have + participio', etc., nanso ɛno yɛ nkɔsoɔ wɔ B1 mu. 

**Nneɛma a wɔnyɛ paa:** Wɔnntɔn 'must' maa wɔbɛka dedukʃɔn; na ɛno akyi, yɛde 'Do you think...' anaa kyerɛw a ɛwɔ hɔ a wɔde 'be' anaa verb bi mu.

title: Relative Clauses: Defining vs. Non-Defining / Nkyerɛase asɛm a ɛtɔ dwuma ne a ɛntɔ dwuma
bridge: Wɔ Twi mu, nkyerɛase asɛm a ɛtɔ dwuma ne a ɛntɔ dwuma bɛyɛ abɛntuma wɔ nkyerɛase: a ɛntɔ dwuma no wɔde abo no sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ. Wɔ English mu, na ɛsɛe abo no, ɛsiane ɛyɛ nkyerɛase a ɛtɔ dwuma no, ɛno a ɛtɔ so ma no, na ɛyɛ nkyerɛase a ɛntɔ dwuma no, ɛno a ɛntɔ so ma no. Nya daakye: wɔ English mu, ɛmmɔ ‘that’ wɔ nkyerɛase a ɛntɔ dwuma no mu.
rule: Nkyerɛase asɛm a ɛtɔ dwuma (ɛma yɛn hu sɛ yɛkae kɔnoma ne nnipa) mmom no mmu abo ne sɛ wɔde ‘that’ anaa ‘who/which’ ma no. Wɔ nkyerɛse a ɛyɛ dɛn na ɛyɛ dɛn mu, ‘that’ (anaa nkyerɛase a ɛyɛ dɛn na ɛyɛ dɛn mu) ɛho nhia: ‘The book (that) I bought’. A ɛntɔ dwuma no (ɛsɛe asɛm bi a ɛntɔ so) wɔde abo ma no ne sɛ wɔde ‘who’ ma nnipa ne ‘which’ ma nnuanom, na ɛmmɔ ‘that’. Nkyerɛase no ɛho nhia wɔ nkyerɛase a ɛntɔ dwuma no mu. Mfonini: Defining: 'The woman who lives next door is a doctor.' (Obaa a ɔdɔ me nni hɔ no yɛ adwenehɔne). Non-defining: 'My sister, who lives in Madrid, is a doctor.' (Me nuaa, a ɔdɔ Madrid mu no, yɛ adwenehɔne).

title: Wish + past / Wish maa ka wo nsisiiw ahoɔden
bridge: Wɔ Twi, yɛnka 'me nea me pɛ' anaa 'me pɛ sɛ' ne subjunctive maa ka wo nsisiiw ahoɔden. Wɔ English, 'wish' ma 'past tense' (simple anaa perfect) maa ka sɛ ɔhaw no nni ho nhyia anaa ɛnyɛ ɔhaw a ɛyɛe wɔ akɔtrɔm. Ɛyɛ ɔkwan a ɛboro sɛ wɔbɛka 'present' anaa 'conditional' ('I wish I have...' anaa 'I wish I would have...'), ɛfiri asɛm a ɛfata Twi. Bu: past tense a wɔde ka wɔ English no mmom nni time, na ɛyɛ nsisii.
rule: Ɛkwan pa a ɛyɛ ne sɛ: **wish + subject + verb wɔ past simple** maa nsisiiw a ɛfata present (nsisiiw anaa nsisiiw a ɛyɛ hyɛ). Sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ ne sɛ: 'I wish I knew the answer' (Me nni hwehwe). Maa nsisiiw a ɛfata past (nea ɛnyɛ yɛe), wɔde **wish + past perfect** maa no ('I wish I had studied more'). Wɔnnyɛ 'would' akyi 'wish' sɛ subject no yɛ hɔ (I wish I would... yɛ ɛho nhyia); wɔde 'would' maa nkyerɛkyerɛ anaa nsisiiw a ɛfata obiara baabi ara (I wish you would stop). Ne 'wish' + 'were' yɛ nea wɔde maa no anaa ako a wɔde 'was' (nanso 'was' yɛ nea wɔde wɔ English a ɛboro). Bu sɛ 'wish' kyerɛkyerɛ bere a woara anaa woatwa so; maa nsisiiw a ɛyɛ yie de 'hope' (I hope you come).

title: Used to / Ka ho nhia ano akyi a wɔn a wɔyɛe no
bridge: Wɔ Twi, yɛbɛka 'ɔyɛe' anaa 'ɔyɛe pii' ma obi a ɔyɛe biribiara. Wɔ English, 'used to' yɛ kyerɛw wɔn a wɔyɛe biribiara a wɔnnyɛ no nkwa. Ɛyɛ den na wɔbɛka 'used to' ne 'be used to' (adi dwuma) anaa 'use to' wɔ mmerɛwa ne hwɛso. Sɛ wopɛ sɛ woabɛka a, ka sɛ 'didn't use to' ne 'Did you use to?'
rule: Used to de kyerɛw wɔn a wɔyɛe biribiara a wɔnnyɛ no nkwa. Sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ ne: subject + used to + verb. Ɛnyɛ wɔ present anaa future; wɔ present yɛde 'usually' + present simple. Mmerɛwa: didn't use to + verb. Hwɛso: Did + subject + use to + verb? (without -d). Nya da: wɔnnyɛ sɛ wɔbɛka 'I use to' wɔ past, na 'used to' nni -ed wɔ past efisɛ ɛyɛ past. 'Would' nso wɔ wɔn a wɔyɛe biribiara a wɔnnyɛ no nkwa, nanso ɛnyɛ wɔ states.

title: Purpose, Cause and Result / Adwuma, Nnyinaso ne Daakye
bridge: Wɔ Twi, yɛnka 'ma wɔ' maa adwuma ne 'efisɛ' maa nnyinaso, na wɔ English, wɔnka 'so that' ne 'because (of)'. Abusua bi a ɛda wɔ hɔ no, 'so that' betumi bu clause bi (subject + verb) akyi, na 'because of' nso betumi bu noun bi akyi. Enti, wɔ English no, wɔnka 'so' (without 'that') maa daakye, a wɔ Twi no, yɛnka 'entɛ' anaa 'na ɛno akyi'.
rule:
Ma wɔaka adwuma, nnyinaso ne daakye wɔ English no, yɛnka nsɛm pii a ɛdi kan no:
- **Adwuma:** 'so that' (ma wɔ) + clause a ɛwɔ verb modal (can, could, will, would) anaa present tense. Kyekye: 'I study so that I can pass the exam.' Ɛno nso betumi ayɛ 'in order to' (ma wɔ) + infinitive, na ɛyɛ formal paa.
- **Nnyinaso:** 'because' (efisɛ) + clause, anaa 'because of' (efisɛ) + noun anaa noun phrase. Kyekye: 'She stayed home because she was sick' (clause) vs. 'She stayed home because of the rain' (noun).
- **Daakye:** 'so' (entɛ) + result clause. Kyekye: 'It was raining, so we stayed home.' Ɛno nso betumi ayɛ 'therefore' (na ɛno akyi) wɔ formal context.
- **Comparison with Twi:** Wɔ Twi, 'ma wɔ' ka subjunctive ('ma wɔ akɔ'), na wɔ English no, wɔnka indicative (normally with 'can' anaa 'could'). Mmom 'so' (daakye) ne 'so that' (adwuma) ntɛm.

title: Common Phrasal Verbs / Mmusuo Afotusem Afotusemmufo Ɛho
bridge: Wɔ Twi mu, mmusuo pii wɔ asɛm kɛse wɔ asɛm bi mu (sɛ 'sokɔ', 'twe'), nanso wɔ English mu, phrasal verbs mmusuo ne sɛnkyerɛnne (up, down, off, etc.) sɛnkyerɛnne biara rekasa ne deɛ ɛkae ne anigye so asɛm. Sɛ 'get up' nni hɔ, ɛnte 'get up' na ɛyɛ 'sokɔ'. Nkɔso biara wɔ hɔ ne sɛ sɛnkyerɛnne no nni nea ɛde bɔne wɔ asɛm no mu na sɛ phrasal verbs no yɛ deɛ ɛha gu mu, ɛsɛ sɛ ɛbɔ object no mu mmusuo ne sɛnkyerɛnne no ho (sɛ 'turn the TV off' anaa 'turn off the TV'), na ɛnyɛ deɛ ɛyɛ Twi mu.
rule: Phrasal verb ne mmusuo ne sɛnkyerɛnne (preposition anaa adverb) a wɔhyɛ hyɛ mu. Asɛm a ɛwɔ kɔtɔɔ no biara nni nea ɛde bɔne wɔ asɛm no mu. Enti, sɛ ɛsɛ sɛ wɔnkae no wɔ asɛm mu, ɛsɛ sɛ wɔnkae wɔn sɛ vocabulary. Mmusuo mmienu wɔ hɔ: transitives ne intransitives. Transitives ne deɛ ɛha gu mu anaa ɛnnyɛ deɛ ɛha gu mu. Wɔ deɛ ɛha gu mu no mu, object (noun anaa pronoun) bi ha gu mmusuo ne sɛnkyerɛnne no ho, nanso sɛ object no yɛ pronoun (it, them, etc.), ɛsɛ sɛ ɛha gu mmusuo ne sɛnkyerɛnne no ho: 'turn it off' (nni 'turn off it'). Wɔ deɛ ɛnnyɛ deɛ ɛha gu mu no mu, object no da biara wɔ sɛnkyerɛnne no akyi: 'look after the children' (nni 'look children after'). Phrasal verbs bi wɔ hɔ a wɔnnyɛ transitives na wɔnnyɛ object biara: 'wake up', 'grow up'. Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔnkae position no ne asɛm no wɔ kontext mu. Wɔ B1 level no, deɛ ɛwɔ hɔ pii ne: get up, wake up, turn on/off, put on, take off, look for, look after, find out, give up, go on, come back, etc.

title: Advanced Quantifiers / Nkyerɛntɔ mma
bridge: Wɔ Twi mu, yɛde 'pocos', 'bastantes', 'casi ningún' maa ɔkwan ne ɔkwan mu, nanso wɔ Twiriso mu, nsɛm nni ɛno biara wɔ nkyerɛntɔ mma no mu, wɔ nkyerɛase ne nnwom mu. Ɛtɔ da biara ne sɛ, 'hardly any' ne 'plenty of' nni ɔkwan biara: 'hardly any' kyerɛ 'casi' ne 'ninguno', na 'plenty of' kyerɛ 'más que suficiente', ɛnyɛ 'mucho'. Ansa na, bu sɛ 'plenty of' demamama wɔ kyerɛw ne deɛ ɛnyɛ kyerɛw anaa sualɛ mu, ɛnyɛ sɛ 'much/many'.
rule: Nkyerɛntɔ mma wɔ Twiriso mu (B1) ne: 'hardly any' (casi ningún/ninguno) dema wɔ ɔkwan mu ne nnwom mu, na ɛwɔ kyerɛw mu (ɛto 'very few' anaa 'very little'). 'Plenty of' (bastante, más que suficiente) dema wɔ kyerɛw mu wɔ ɔkwan mu ne nnwom mu (ɛnyɛ wɔ sualɛ mu anaa kyerɛw mu). Nkyerɛntɔ foforo: 'a good deal of' (bastante, formal, nnwom), 'a large amount of' (una gran cantidad de, nnwom), 'a large number of' (un gran número de, ɔkwan), 'a couple of' (un par de, ɔkwan). Faako: 'plenty of' dema aha ɔkwan anaa kyerɛw, ɛnyɛ adwuma. 'Hardly any' dema aha ɔkwan na ɛsɛe wɔ 'there is/are' mu. Wɔ sualɛ ne kyerɛw mu, wɔde 'much' anaa 'many' nkae 'plenty'.

title: Verb patterns: verb + infinitive / gerund / Nkyea ako a edwuma: edwuma + mframa / gerundio
bridge: Wɔ Twi, afe a yɛbɛka edwuma pono a, yɛnkyea mframa (e.g. 'me pɛ me di', 'mɛbɔ me nkyɛn'). Nanso, wɔ English, mmienu a edwuma (sɛ 'enjoy', 'avoid', 'finish') kɔka gerundio (-ing), na mmienu a (sɛ 'want', 'decide', 'hope') kɔka mframa ne 'to'. Enti, edwuma bi wɔ hɔ a wɔde mframa anaa gerundio ma wɔwɔ hɔ a, wɔde wɔn kyerɛw wɔ kasa (e.g. 'stop to smoke' vs. 'stop smoking'). Nnipa a ɛha gu no, ɛyɛ den sɛ yɛbɛka English kɛse.
rule: Wɔ English, edwuma pono ne edwuma biara wɔ hɔ a wɔde mframa a wɔtɔ so 'to' (I want to go) anaa gerundio (-ing) (I enjoy going). Adwene a ɛbɛka no, ɛte edwuma pono no so. Nnipa a ɛha gu no: - Edwuma a wɔde mframa ma wɔn: want, need, decide, hope, plan, promise, agree, offer, forget, learn, etc. - Edwuma a wɔde gerundio ma wɔn: enjoy, finish, avoid, mind, consider, suggest, practice, admit, deny, etc. - Edwuma a wɔde mframa anaa gerundio ma wɔn a, wɔn kyerɛw nte: start, begin, continue, like, love, hate, prefer. - Edwuma a wɔde wɔn kyerɛw wɔ kasa: remember, forget, stop, try, regret. (E.g. 'Remember to lock the door' = yɛbɛka sɛ yɛbɛtwa mu; 'Remember locking the door' = yɛbɛka sɛ yɛatwa mu). Hwɛ: edwuma a wɔde ma wɔn sɛ wɔhu anaa sɛ wɔde 'make' anaa 'let' ma wɔn, yɛde mframa a yɛntɔ so 'to' (I saw him leave, They made me wait). Afei, sɛ yɛbɛka sɛ yɛmmu, yɛde 'not' ma yɛtɔ mframa anaa gerundio no (I decided not to go, I enjoy not working).

title: Articles Advanced: Zero Article and Generic Use / Nkyerɛntɔm Nyansa: Nkyerɛntɔn a ɛnyɛ ne Nkyerɛ a Wɔde Maa Nyɛma
bridge: Wɔ Twi, yɛnkyerɛ a wɔde maa nyɛma no, yɛntumi nkyerɛ a wɔde maa nneɛma pɛpɛɛpɛ (sɛ, 'nnamfo no yɛ den'). Wɔ Twirɛ, wɔnkyerɛ a wɔde maa nneɛma pɛpɛɛpɛ no, wɔntumi nkyerɛ biara: 'Nnamfo yɛ den'. Yɛn ara nso, wɔntumi nkyerɛ a wɔde maa nnamfo a wɔbɛka ho asɛm biara ('Mepɛ rice'), na wɔ Twi, wɔde nkyerɛ a wɔde maa nnamfo no ('Mepɛ ɔho').
rule: Wɔ Twirɛ, ɛto so ara nkyerɛ a wɔde maa nneɛma pɛpɛɛpɛ no, ɛyɛ ɛto so ara: 1) Sɛ woka ho asɛm a wɔde maa nneɛma pɛpɛɛpɛ ne nneɛma a wɔntumi nnyɛ (sɛ, 'Nnamfo yɛ akoma', 'Water yɛ paa'). 2) Nnamfo a wɔde maa nnamfo, kasa, mmoa ne nneɛma a wɔde kɔ so (sɛ, 'Mekasa English', 'She play tennis'). 3) Nneɛma a wɔde maa nneɛma sɛ 'school', 'hospital', 'church', 'prison' sɛ woka ho asɛm a wɔde maa nneɛma no (sɛ, 'He go to school' - sɛ ɔyɛ student, ɔnyɛ visitor). Nkyerɛ: Nneɛma a wɔde maa nneɛma biara, ɛsɛe nkyerɛ bi ara ne nneɛma biara, ɛwom sɛ ɛyɛ nneɛma biara (sɛ, 'A dog yɛ man's best friend' anaa 'The dog yɛ den'). Wɔntumi ka sɛ 'Dog yɛ den' sɛ woka ho asɛm a wɔde maa nnamfo no. Afei, wɔ Twirɛ, wɔntumi 'the' a wɔde maa nneɛma a wɔde maa nneɛma biara (sɛ, 'Italy', 'Spain'), nanso wɔde 'the' a wɔde maa nneɛma a wɔde 'republic', 'kingdom' anaa 'states' (sɛ, 'the United States').

concept_examples.text: She plays tennis on weekends.

concept_examples.text: Life is full of surprises.

concept_examples.phonetic: /laɪf ɪz fʊl əv sərˈpraɪzɪz/

common_error.explanation: Wɔ Twi, yɛka sɛ 'ahofama yɛ den' na yɛde nkyerɛ a wɔde maa ahofama no, na yɛka ho asɛm a wɔde maa ahofama no. Wɔ Twirɛ, sɛ woka ho asɛm a wɔde maa nneɛma pɛpɛɛpɛ (life, love, happiness), wɔde nkyerɛ a ɛnyɛ. Sɛ woka sɛ 'The life' no, ɛkyerɛ sɛ woka ho asɛm a wɔde maa ahofama biara, sɛ 'the life of a star'. Nkyerɛ no yɛ: nneɛma a wɔntumi nnyɛ anaa nneɛma pɛpɛɛpɛ no, wɔntumi 'the' sɛ wɔnkyerɛ a wɔde maa nneɛma no.

examples.note: Nneɛma pɛpɛɛpɛ sɛ 'ahofama' no, wɔntumi nkyerɛ biara sɛ ɛyɛ nneɛma biara.

examples.original: I have breakfast at seven.

examples.phonetic: /wiː went tə bed ˈɜːli/
examples.translation: Yɛnna yɛn ntɔmw.
examples.note: Kyerɛw a wɔde maa nneɛma sɛ 'go to bed', 'go to work', 'at home' no, wɔntumi nkyerɛ biara.
